title: Tarunima Vijra joins ArbBoutique as Managing Counsel
description: Tarunima Vijra has joined ArbBoutique as a Managing Counsel.Vijra is a 2011 alumna of West Bengal National University of Juridical Sciences. She earned her LLM in International Dispute Settlement from Geneva Graduate Institute in 2017.Vijra has fifteen years of experience in international arbitration and investment treaty disputes.
